questions.prompt: A 120-liter tank contains a 30% salt solution. After draining 40 liters and replacing it with pure water, the mixture is stirred uniform. Then 30 liters are drained and replaced with a 50% salt solution. What is the final salt concentration?
questions.explanation: After first replacement: remaining salt = 0.30 × 80 = 24 kg in 120 L, so 20% concentration. After second replacement: 30 L of 20% solution removed contains 6 kg salt, leaving 18 kg. Adding 30 L of 50% solution adds 15 kg salt. Final: 33 kg / 120 L = 27.5%.
